name: Anil Sharma
summary:
Senior Infrastructure and Information Security
Leader with 16+ years of experience in enterprise
vulnerability management, regulatory compliance,
and resilient IT operations. Expert in leveraging AI
and Generative AI for risk-based remediation,
audit automation, and predictive security. Proven
CXO-level stakeholder engagement as primary
SPOC for RBI and ISO audits, ISMS governance,
and strategic vendor management. Holds an MBA
in IT Operations and certifications including AWS
Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C02) and
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
Skilled in cloud security architecture, governance,
risk management, and aligning security strategy
with business goals to enhance cyber resilience
and compliance maturity across hybrid and cloud
environments.
